basic.name: Oracle Brush
basic.description_template: Deals Physical DMG equal to {{damage}}% of 's ATK to one designated enemy.

skill.name: Samsara, Locked
skill.description_template: Deals Physical DMG equal to {{skill_damage}}% of Hanya's ATK to one designated enemy target, then applies "Burden" to them. For every 2 Basic ATKs, Skills, or Ultimates allies use on an enemy with "Burden," allies will immediately recover 1 Skill Point. "Burden" is only active on the latest target it is applied to, and will be dispelled automatically after the Skill Point recovery effect has been triggered 2 times.

ultimate.name: Ten-Lords' Decree, All Shall Obey
ultimate.description_template: Increases the SPD of a target ally by {{spd_buff}}% of Hanya's SPD and increases the same target ally's ATK by {{atk_buff}}%, lasting for 2 turn(s).

talent.name: Sanction
talent.description_template: When an ally uses a Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate on an enemy inflicted with Burden, the DMG dealt increases by {{dmg_buff}}%, lasting for 2 turn(s).

technique.name: Netherworld Judgment
technique.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, applies Burden equivalent to that applied by the Skill to a random enemy.

2.name: Scrivener
2.description: Allies triggering Burden's Skill Point recovery effect have their ATK increased by 10% for 1 turn(s).

4.name: Netherworld
4.description: If the trigger count for the Burden's Skill Point recovery effect is 1 or lower when an enemy with Burden is defeated, then additionally recovers 1 Skill Point(s).

6.name: Reanimated
6.description: When Burden's Skill Point recovery effect is triggered, this character regenerates 2 Energy.

eidolons.name: One Heart
eidolons.description: When an ally target with Hanya's Ultimate effect defeats an enemy, Hanya's action advances by 15%. This effect can only be triggered 1 time(s) per turn.

eidolons.name: Two Views
eidolons.description: After using the Skill, this character's SPD increases by 20% for 1 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Three Temptations
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Four Truths
eidolons.description: The Ultimate's duration is additionally extended for 1 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Five Skandhas
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Six Reverences
eidolons.description: Increase the DMG Boost effect of the Talent by an additional 10%.
